name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
notes: A Hydro healer that scales with Max HP: Kurage's Oath heals 4.4% Max HP + 424 per pulse at level 1, and the Burst's Skill DMG and DMG bonuses take percentages of Max HP. The 'check' line Ripple DMG in the Skill is an ATK multiplier. KQM puts the Skill level with character level 90 and ahead of the Burst; Game8 gives the same order for the sub-DPS and support builds (Burst first only for a main DPS), so the damage talent is the Skill. The sources agree on three builds: on-field Hydro DPS (4pc Ocean-Hued Clam, Hydro DMG Goblet), off-field support (4pc Tenacity of the Millelith, HP% Goblet, Healing Bonus Circlet) and Bloom (EM on every slot, Flower of Paradise Lost); the card follows the support build and lists the Hydro DMG Goblet as its second choice. Everlasting Moonglow is first for the DPS builds in both and Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers for the support build. Neither source gives stat goals. The only goal is ER, KQM's off-field range with Prototype Amber R1 (215-260%, upper end used); base it is 260-315% and with Prototype Amber R5 195-235%.
